text.content:
The biggest bedroom in Night City.

Region: Night City, east side
Controlled by: The city in the Glen; the Valentinos in Vista del Rey
Feel: Luxury apartments and slums side by side
Notable locations: The Glen: City Hall, El Coyote Cojo (Mamá Welles), Embers, Reconciliation Park, Time Machine. Vista del Rey: Delamain HQ, Dicky Twister, La Catrina, Mercado Sonora (by Megabuilding H5). Wellsprings: Bulwark, the old Water Treatment Facility

More people live in Heywood than anywhere else in the city. It was once South Night City, a combat zone, until reclaimers cleaned it up after the 4th Corporate War; then the people of North Heywood moved in, pushed the reclaimers out, and gave it their name.

The Glen was built as the new seat of city government and is tidy near Reconciliation Park and shabby at its edges. Vista del Rey is the poorest part and mostly Valentinos turf. Wellsprings is safe middle-class housing near City Center and run-down further out.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.18
